Home / The house

A whole house,
all to yourselves.

Eight bedrooms, generous shared spaces and the peace of the Pays d’Auge. Up to 15 guests.

Luxury property in the heart of Normandy, just 1 hour 45 minutes from Paris and 20 minutes from Deauville and Honfleur.

We have designed our home with your comfort in mind: the comfort and luxury of a hotel, the facilities of a holiday resort, with added privacy and tranquillity.

Le Domaine aux Lions is located in a small, peaceful hamlet in the heart of the Normandy countryside, surrounded by fields.

Our large, charming and fully renovated house features 8 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, an indoor jacuzzi, a spacious living room with fireplace, pool table (billiards), table football, piano and more.

Outside, enjoy a covered and secure swimming pool, heated to 28°C all year round (temperature may vary during exceptionally cold weather), a terrace with BBQ and table tennis, as well as a tennis court.

WiFi and high-speed fibre internet are available throughout the property.

15guests maximum

room for art.

The bedrooms bear the names of painters from the region. Reproductions of Normandy paintings and contemporary works accompany your stay throughout the house.

Everything is possible at the Domaine

Private parking for 8 cars 50 meters ahead of the entry.

For your arrival, beds will be made, bathroom and pool towels provided. We take care of cleaning after you leave, we only ask you to take care of the kitchen and kitchenware. Your bins must be sorted and left in the containers behind the house (we will take care of transporting them to public containers).

Additional services can be provided on request: baby-sitting, fun activities for children and adults, catering, massages…

To enjoy all of the above, we kindly ask you:

  • Avoid any noise or loud music outside to respect the tranquillity of the place. We cannot hold loud parties, even in the daytime. Please strictly no noise after 11 pm.
  • A deposit of 1500€ is required
  • 2 nights minimum rental in low season, 5 nights minimum during school holidays
  • Numerous availabilities ON WEEKDAYS at a fair price for your seminars, retreats, or simply shifted holidays. Please don’t hesitate to contact us

We are looking forward to welcoming you soon, and to see smiles on your faces at the end of your stay!
